# Bulge & pinch

A round lens that magnifies the image toward its center (bulge) or squeezes it (pinch). In the demo it follows the pointer.

<EffectDemo effect="bulge" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { bulge } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/bulge';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(bulge({ preset: 'magnifier' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.center = [0.5, 0.5]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type   | Default      | Range    | Description                                            |
| ---------- | ------ | ------------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `center`   | [x, y] | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1    | Center of the lens (follows the pointer in the demo).  |
| `radius`   | number | `0.3`        | 0.05 – 1 | Radius of the lens, as a fraction of the frame height. |
| `strength` | number | `0.5`        | -1 – 1   | Positive magnifies, negative pinches.                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- |
| `magnifier` | `strength: 0.8`, `radius: 0.2`  |
| `pinch`     | `strength: -0.6`                |
| `subtle`    | `strength: 0.25`, `radius: 0.5` |
| `bubble`    | `strength: 1`, `radius: 0.35`   |

Apply one with `bulge({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/bulge`, including the shared effect runtime.
